description: Preserve approval authority, emergency review deadline, and rollback exception.

messages.content:
Summarize the deployment policy as JSON. Use snake_case role names for standard_approver and emergency_authority; give retrospective_business_days as an integer and rollback_during_outage as a boolean.
<prism-source id="standard">Standard deployments require manager approval recorded in the change ticket.</prism-source>
<prism-source id="emergency">Emergency deployments may proceed with incident commander authorization. A retrospective review is required within one business day.</prism-source>
<prism-source id="rollback">Rollback to the last known good version is permitted during an active outage.</prism-source>
Return the requested JSON fields using the supplied evidence.

description: Combine incident facts with a runbook recommendation.

messages.content:
Produce service, severity, and recommended_action as JSON. Use the single action name rollback where appropriate.
<prism-source id="incident">The affected service is checkout. Severity is high. HTTP 500 errors started immediately after the new release.</prism-source>
<prism-source id="runbook">For HTTP 500 errors beginning immediately after a new release, the recommended_action is rollback to the last known good release.</prism-source>

description: Retain UTF-8 names and distinguish days from hours.

messages.content:

<prism-source id="refund">Café München offers refunds within 14 days. The refund currency is EUR. A receipt is required.</prism-source>
<prism-source id="shipping">Orders ship within 72 hours. This shipping target does not alter the refund period.</prism-source>

description: Preserve a prohibition and its authorization exception.

messages.content:
Return routine_changes_permitted during an active outage as a boolean and emergency_authority as a snake_case role name.
<prism-source id="routine">Routine changes are prohibited while an outage is active.</prism-source>
<prism-source id="exception">Emergency changes during an outage require incident commander authorization.</prism-source>

description: Select the effective policy instead of a superseded distractor.

messages.content:

<prism-source id="current">Revision 2026-10 is effective from 2026-10-01. Audit records must be retained for 90 days.</prism-source>
